full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cinematic photograph shows a woman and a man close together in a dim interior, their faces filling most of the frame. The background is nearly black, with only a narrow vertical edge at the left and a small pale patch high behind them hinting at the room. The woman stands at the left in three-quarter view, her dark hair gathered back and softly waved around her face. A small dark mark sits above her brows, and a light earring catches the available light. She looks downward with a restrained, thoughtful expression, wearing a draped patterned garment whose border crosses the lower part of the image. The man leans in from the right, his head bowed near her temple and his gaze directed down toward her face. Short dark hair, a fine mustache, and the open collar of a pale shirt are visible. Their heads nearly touch, and the closeness makes the dark surrounding space feel even quieter. Soft side light from the upper left models her cheek and the man's forehead and nose, then falls away into deep shadow along their hair and shoulders. The two faces remain clear despite gentle film grain and slight softness at the edges. Gray tones vary through skin, cloth, and the dark background without any bright decorative accents. The cropping excludes their hands and most of the room, concentrating the image on their expressions and the narrow space between them. The overall composition creates an intimate pause through close placement, low light, and subdued tonal contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白电影感照片描绘一名女子和一名男子在昏暗室内相互靠近，两张面容占据画面大部。背景近乎全黑，只有左侧一道窄竖边和两人身后上方一小块浅色暗示房间。女子站在左侧，呈四分之三视角，深色头发向后拢起，在面旁柔和卷曲。眉间上方有一个小深色印记，一枚浅色耳饰接住现有光线。她低头看着下方，神情克制而若有所思，身上披着带纹样的衣料，其边饰横过画面下部。男子从右侧俯身靠近，头低在她的太阳穴旁，视线朝她的面部下方。他的短黑发、细胡须与浅色衬衫敞开的领口可见。两人的头几乎相触，亲近距离使周围深色空间显得更加安静。来自左上方的柔和侧光塑造她的脸颊与男子的额头、鼻梁，随后沿头发和肩膀落入深影。尽管有轻柔胶片颗粒和边缘的轻微柔化，两张面容仍然清楚。灰阶在皮肤、衣料和深色背景间变化，没有明亮的装饰强调。裁切排除了双手和房间大部，把影像集中在表情及两人之间的狭窄空间。整体构图借紧密的位置、低光和压低的色调反差形成亲密的停顿。
style_prompt_en: The image has a black-and-white cinematic photographic finish with gentle film grain and close, emotionally focused framing. Soft silver-gray facial planes emerge from a broad charcoal field, while clothing and background blend into lower values. Light enters from one side and falls off quickly, modeling selected edges without a glossy or theatrical shine. Fine grain and mild optical softness temper the sharpest features, and the deepest shadows retain little detail. The composition favors closely overlapping forms, cropped edges, and narrow negative spaces; a few brighter accents guide attention across the dark field. Tonal transitions are smooth on focal surfaces but abrupt where they disappear into black. The overall effect is intimate, restrained, and quietly dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有带轻柔胶片颗粒、贴近情绪焦点裁切的黑白电影摄影质感。柔银灰的焦点平面从宽广炭黑色域中浮现，次要织物与背景则融入较低明度。光从一侧进入并迅速衰减，塑造选定边缘，却没有光滑或舞台式亮泽。细颗粒与轻微镜头柔化缓和最尖锐的特征，最深阴影只保留少许细节。构图偏好紧密重叠的形体、被裁切的边缘和狭窄留白；几点较亮的强调在深色域中引导注意力。焦点表面的色调过渡平顺，消失于黑暗处则骤然转折。整体效果亲密、克制且安静地富有戏剧性。
theme_en: A quiet black-and-white close-up of two people together
theme_zh: 两人相依的安静黑白特写
name: Satyajit Ray
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
